_doc: Theme pack for 三国 episodes. Project script.json sets "theme": "sanguo". head=1: scenes[:1] open the video, the rest close it. Run panels.py / voice.py / bgm.py in THIS dir to (re)make its assets.
style: ONE single full-bleed illustration showing ONE camera shot: no comic page, no panel grid, no frames or borders, no insets; each character appears at most once. Japanese gag manga art (Gintama energy) with Chinese ink-wash touches: bold black ink lines, screentone shading, mostly black and white with spot RED accents only, exaggerated comedic faces, speed lines. SETTING: late Eastern Han dynasty, Three Kingdoms era China, location as described in SCENE. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no letters, no calligraphy, no signs, no speech bubbles anywhere in the image.

L.name: 刘备
L.look: LIU BEI: gentle kind-faced man ~40, long earlobes, neat short beard, cream-white Eastern Han cross-collar robe with wide sleeves, black jinxian scholar cap; NOT Qing, NOT Japanese.
L.persona: 刘备，温厚圆滑的中年男人，男中音

G.name: 关羽
G.look: GUAN YU: tall stern man, deep RED face, very long flowing black beard to the chest, phoenix eyes, green Eastern Han robe over armor, green headscarf.
G.persona: 关羽，高冷威严的中年男人，低沉男声，惜字如金

Z.name: 张飞
Z.look: ZHANG FEI: burly loud man, dark tanned face, huge round leopard eyes, wild bristly black beard, black Eastern Han robe over dark armor, black headscarf.
Z.persona: 张飞，粗犷莽撞的黑脸大汉，粗哑的男低音

C.name: 曹操
C.look: CAO CAO: sly grinning warlord ~45, chalk-pale face, thin curled mustache and small goatee, narrow scheming eyes, black-and-gold Eastern Han robe, tall black official crown hat.
C.persona: 曹操，奸诈爱装的中年男人，油滑的男中音

drums.prompt: huge ancient chinese war drums roll building to one big hit and a gong crash, epic, no melody

jingle.prompt: short cheerful comedic chinese outro jingle, pipa and erhu flourish, ends with a small gong hit

scenes.art: Epic comedic title shot on a windy hill at dawn: LIU BEI, GUAN YU and ZHANG FEI stand back to back in heroic poses, blank red battle banners flapping (NO writing on the banners), dust clouds and radiating speed lines, a huge red sun behind them; CAO CAO peeks sneakily from behind a rock at the right edge. All characters are in the TOP 55% of the image; the lower 45% is only empty ground, dust and screentone.
